# float64 fast-path cases, our own (ADR-0012, ADR-0027). Each line: the
# bits of the text's nearest float64, ties to even, as 16 hex digits; a
# space; the text. Bits from Python 3.10's float() on the host, checked by
# rounding each text's exact value, 2026-11-11. A line starting # is a
# comment.
#
# The bounds of json-assembler-number!'s fast path, either side, and
# texts that one flonum operation (the significand to a flonum, then times
# or over 10^|e|) rounds wrong, so a wrong cap gives a wrong value.
# tests/test-float64.sps pins which lines one operation rounds wrong.
# integers of 1, 18 and 19 digits, and 2^60 - 1 and 2^60
0000000000000000 0
3FF0000000000000 1
43ABC16D674EC800 999999999999999999
4376345785D8A000 100000000000000000
43E158E460913D00 9999999999999999999
43B0000000000000 1152921504606846975
43B0000000000000 1152921504606846976
